notes: A security-hardening patch: API-key management, the migration wizard, subscriber exports and backup downloads are now instance-admin-only, and username-probing endpoints are closed. It also introduces Custom URI links (#129) so any non-web scheme like xmpp:, matrix: or nostr: can be linked safely, alongside a live Rich-preview thumbnail in the link dialog, markdown bold/italic that compose with links, and a group of dependency updates.
